title: Subsystem Status Report
instructions:
Complete the `printAllStatuses` function. It takes a `List<Subsystem>` and prints the `status()` of each subsystem, one per line.

The parent class and two child classes are already written for you. Do not change them.

Expected output:
```
Drivetrain: 4 motors active
Shooter: ready to launch
Intake: OK
```
hint: Use a `for` loop to go through each subsystem in the list and call `println(sub.status())` on each one.
expectedOutput:
Drivetrain: 4 motors active
Shooter: ready to launch
Intake: OK
